CHAPTER 7 · ITEM 05 / 10

Consumer and producer surplus

Fixed fee versus per use固定費與按次收費

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Compare a fixed-fee service with a per-use charge: identify the marginal cost faced by the consumer, the quantity chosen and net benefit after the fixed fee.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

使用量取決於邊際價格；比較整體淨收益時要扣所有付款，包括固定費。固定費影響是否訂閱，訂閱後的零邊際費可增加使用。

Choose usage using the marginal price, then subtract all payments including fixed fees from total willingness to pay. A fixed fee affects whether to subscribe, while a zero per-use price can increase usage after subscribing.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Demand Q=10−P. Free usage plus $20 fee yields Q=10, total value=50 and net surplus=30. Per-use price $2 yields Q=8 and CS=32. 按次方案淨收益較高。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

For Q=10−P with per-use P=2 and no fixed fee, quantity? 每次兩元，觀看量？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
